fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native OStim scene menus and shared node/speed/stop control for every involved player, free-scene STR proxy root-motion alignment, Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes, and OCum state snapshots before acceptance.
